stem_book: If equation x² + px + r = 0 and x² + 2x + 1 = 0 have root common and q is common root, find the values of p, q and r.
derived: q = −1, 1 − p + r = 0 (p, r not unique)
reason: Recap Q3 part (iii); as printed ('have root common') only q = −1 and 1 − p + r = 0 follow, so p, r have no unique values; key p=2, r=1 needs an unstated 'both roots common'
